title: ICT 2024 Mentorship - Foundational Concepts & Algorithmic Mechanics

concepts.name: Interbank Price Delivery Algorithm Time Windows
concepts.summary: Institutions do not trade 24/7. Price delivery is governed by algorithmic clocks called Killzones. Trading outside these windows results in spread widening, whipsaws, and low liquidity.

LONDON.role: Manipulation (Judas Swing) raiding Asian session liquidity. Sets the high or low of the daily range for Forex & Gold.

NEW_YORK_AM.role: Distribution & primary expansion for US Index Futures (NQ) and Metals (GC, SI).

ASIAN_MACRO.role: CME Futures re-open macro; trades early Asian imbalance before entering consolidation.

dead_zones: 11:30 - 13:30 EST (New York Lunch): High churn, book rebalancing, no edge.
04:30 - 08:00 EST (Inter-Session Transition): European close to US pre-open lull.
17:00 - 18:00 EST (CME Daily Maintenance Halt): Exchange closed.

concepts.name: Accumulation, Manipulation, Distribution (AMD)
concepts.summary: The master daily liquidity template of the market maker.

phases.A_Accumulation: Asian session builds a tight consolidation, engineering resting Buy Stops above and Sell Stops below.
phases.M_Manipulation: London Open stages an aggressive false breakout (Judas Swing) into the Asian liquidity pool to accumulate orders.
phases.D_Distribution: New York session expands price in the true institutional direction into higher-timeframe targets.

concepts.name: Buy-Side Liquidity (BSL) & Sell-Side Liquidity (SSL)
concepts.summary: Resting stop orders that provide the counterparty volume needed for large institutional orders to fill.

types.BSL: Buy Stop orders resting above swing highs, session highs, and equal highs.
types.SSL: Sell Stop orders resting below swing lows, session lows, and equal lows.

concepts.rule: Never trade until price has wicked through a major liquidity pool. Entering before the sweep means becoming the liquidity.
